title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jazzy, second‑set‑driven 1973 performance featuring a stellar Dark Star and Eyes of the World with crisp clarity.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this show as one of the very best of ’73, highlighting a monumental, jazz‑infused second set that includes a soaring Dark Star and an inspired Eyes of the World. The soundboard source is praised for its crystal‑clear, crisp mix despite occasional re‑tracking, making the performance fully enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one brief review are five‑star and praise both the musical performance and the soundboard clarity; the lone three‑star comment is dismissed by another reviewer, so overall rating is near perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with no noticeable dropouts; reviewers note re‑tracking but say the sound remains phenomenal and highly listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as jazzy, monumental and seamlessly flowing; overall pacing praised with strong transitions and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Steers the ship into Dark Star's first verse and provides tight leadership throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned wanting The Other One, but no specific bass performance comments.
band_member_comments.Bob: Subtly 'noodles' with a Mind Left Body vibe early in Dark Star, showcasing nuanced rhythm work.
